notes: Rewards can be earned by completing floors of the tower for the first time.
Lottery Coins are also rewarded for completing a floor for the first time.

Separately to the first completion rewards, the player receives Lottery Coins whenever they clear a floor (even of repeated attempts). On the first clear, these are awarded in addition to the first completion rewards.
If the player loses the Duel, they instead receive half this amount (rounded down).

The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times. When purchasing one of the latter, the player can chose how many copies they wish to exchange.

The player can spend a multiple of 30 Lottery Coins (max. 300 at a time) to obtain one random reward for each 30 Lottery Coins spent. The Lottery remained available until after the event's conclusion, and could be accessed from the "Information" menu.
